dedupe_keys.name: blue green wave champs sur marne green roof water balance measurements february to may 2018

description: This data set records the water balance of the Blue Green Wave, a 1 hectare green roof at Champs-sur-Marne that is the largest in the greater Paris area, converted into a full-scale monitoring site for green infrastructure in stormwater management. The Hydrology, Meteorology and Complexity lab of École des Ponts ParisTech measured rainfall, water content in the substrate and discharge flowing out of the roof, and described the data in Earth System Science Data on 6 May 2020. Coverage is one site over 78 days from 19 February to 7 May 2018. Format and access: CSV files for rainfall, water content and discharge with a Python program that turns raw data into hydrological quantities, free on Zenodo. Licence: the paper is CC-BY-4.0; the data set licence was not read. Caveats: a short spring period, and water content sensors were moved and often removed at night. It supports calibration of green roof hydrology models for climate adaptation of urban drainage. Related catalogue records are the NGIF sensor data from Newcastle and the Toronto GRIT Lab.
